reuse.why: Uses the existing db.first query helper and adds one guard reused by all five link handlers; there was no existing link-uniqueness helper to reuse.

duplication.why: The uniqueness rule is written once and each provider only passes its own source, id and upgradingId.

placement.why: The guard sits in accounts/app.ts next to the link handlers that use it; it could arguably live in accounts/link.ts with findOrCreateBank, but this is consistent with the file.

scope.why: Focused on the guard; in linkEnableBankingAccount the call is inserted between an explanatory comment and the findOrCreateBank call it describes, and no tests accompany the change.

maintainability.why: One small, well-named guard; adding a new provider requires remembering to call it, as with the rest of the per-provider link boilerplate.

one_place.where: assertNotLinkedElsewhere in accounts/app.ts holds the 'already linked' rule; all five provider link handlers (GoCardless, SimpleFin, PluggyAi, Akahu, EnableBanking) call it before any write.
